candidates.title: Deep Agents
candidates.selection_value: Official overview of the DeepAgents harness, tools, context management, subagents, security, and framework-selection boundaries.
intended_questions: When should a project use DeepAgents instead of LangGraph directly?
candidates.decision_reason: Selected as the broad but compact authoritative product overview.

candidates.title: DeepAgents Python Package README
candidates.selection_value: Official package-level installation and usage guidance for the same DeepAgents API.
intended_questions: How is the Python package installed and initialized?
candidates.decision_reason: Not selected because it substantially duplicates the root README without adding a distinct engineering question set.

candidates.title: LangGraph
candidates.selection_value: Official high-level framework overview covering controllable agents, memory, and deployment links.
intended_questions: What is LangGraph designed to orchestrate?
candidates.decision_reason: Not selected because the checkpoint README provides denser, more testable definitions for persistence boundaries.

candidates.title: LangGraph Checkpoint
candidates.selection_value: Focused official definitions for checkpoints, threads, serializers, pending writes, and persistence interfaces.
intended_questions: How do checkpoints and threads relate?
candidates.decision_reason: Selected for precise persistence terminology and cross-section questions.

candidates.title: Python Qdrant Client
candidates.selection_value: Official client documentation for in-memory and path-backed local mode plus local FastEmbed inference.
intended_questions: How do Qdrant memory and path modes differ?
How does local inference integrate with the client?
candidates.decision_reason: Selected because it directly explains the storage and inference boundaries used by this project.

candidates.title: FastEmbed
candidates.selection_value: Official ONNX embedding documentation covering dense, sparse, late-interaction, reranking, and initialization.
candidates.decision_reason: Selected to separate embedding generation from vector storage and retrieval.

candidates.title: LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
candidates.selection_value: Authoritative security guidance for indirect injection, RAG poisoning, structured separation, least privilege, and testing.
intended_questions: Why is retrieved content untrusted data?
Which defenses reduce agentic RAG injection risk?
candidates.decision_reason: Selected because it directly supports the system's model-visible untrusted-source boundary.

candidates.title: AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet
candidates.selection_value: Authoritative broader guidance for agent tools, permissions, memory, identity, and observability.
intended_questions: How should agent tool permissions and identity be constrained?
candidates.decision_reason: Not selected because its security coverage overlaps heavily with the chosen prompt-injection source and would dominate the small corpus.

candidates.title: Ragas RAG Evaluation and Metrics
candidates.selection_value: Official definitions that distinguish context precision, context recall, relevance, faithfulness, and end-to-end evaluation.
intended_questions: How do context precision and recall differ?
Why is faithfulness not answer correctness?
candidates.decision_reason: Selected to support precise evaluation language and prevent unsupported accuracy claims.
